response.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT c.town_city AS town, ili.order_item_id, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.town_city, ili.order_item_id), per_town AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_item GROUP BY town), cross_town AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_town) SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - x.avg_ratio AS ratio_excess FROM per_town AS t CROSS JOIN cross_town AS x WHERE t.avg_ratio > x.avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: A zero total cost makes the ratio undefined, so that ratio is excluded from averages. Rows without a town are excluded.
